values.note: $22 a site (two vehicles or one RV); $10 a third vehicle. Senior/Access passes halve the site fee.

note: Salida RD campground in Chalk Creek Canyon at ~10,000 ft, 0.5 mi up CR 292 from CR 162 just east of the St. Elmo ghost town (walkable); popular ATV country, with the old Iron City cemetery at the east end. CR 162 is paved then gravel. Camping in the canyon is limited to its four developed campgrounds; overflow is allowed above St. Elmo on CR 267. --Claude
